entities.summary: Unas or Wenis, also spelled Unis, was a king, the ninth and last ruler of the Fifth Dynasty of Egypt during the Old Kingdom. Unas reigned for around 30 years in the mid-24th century BC, succeeding Djedkare Isesi, who might have been his father.
